Output of `forgecycle help` for ForgeCycle 0.6.0. Each command's own help follows on the [project](/documentation/reference/cli-project/), [task](/documentation/reference/cli-task/), and [roadmap](/documentation/reference/cli-roadmap/) command pages.

```text
Usage: forgecycle <command> [options] [arguments]
       forgecycle task <command> [options] [arguments]
       forgecycle roadmap <command> [options] [arguments]

ForgeCycle runs a task through Planner, Builder, and Reviewer turns in an
isolated Git worktree, and splits a large plan into a roadmap of tasks. Run
project commands inside a Git repository.

Project commands:
  init       Set a project up: its configuration and the agent skill
  doctor     Check configuration and adapter availability
  status     List unfinished task runs and roadmap runs
  pause      Stop what is running after its current turn
  unpause    Cancel a pending pause, or continue what paused
  prune      Delete all task run worktrees and stored task and roadmap runs
  serve      Serve the local observability dashboard for this project
  observe    Summarize candidate quality from the operation journal
  update     Replace this forgecycle binary with a release
  version    Print the ForgeCycle version
  help       Show the command overview or one command's help

Task commands:
  run        Start a Planner–Builder–Reviewer task run for one task
  status     Show a task run's state, its stop, and what to do next
  resume     Continue a paused, blocked, failed, or interrupted task run
  approve    Approve a task run waiting at an approval gate
  reject     Reject an approval gate with written feedback
  abandon    Stop a task run and release its repository reservation
  clean      Remove a finished task run's worktree

Roadmap commands:
  decompose  Assess a large plan and write ordered task files
  questions  Rewrite unclear decisions and add the ones a roadmap misses
  run        Run a roadmap's tasks in order, each on the previous one's head
  status     Show a roadmap run's tasks, its stop, and what to do next
  resume     Continue a stopped, failed, or interrupted roadmap run
  abandon    Stop a roadmap run; keep its integration branch and task runs

Options:
  -h, --help     Show this help; after a command, that command's help
  -V, --version  Print the version

Get started:
  forgecycle init
  $EDITOR .forgecycle/config.json
  forgecycle doctor
  forgecycle task run tasks/my-task.md

For a large plan:
  forgecycle roadmap decompose plans/large-plan.md
  $EDITOR tasks/<generated-dir>/decisions.md
  forgecycle roadmap questions tasks/<generated-dir>
  forgecycle roadmap run tasks/<generated-dir>
Review the roadmap and answer every decision before running it, so the run does
not stop to ask.

Exit status:
  0    Success, or the run is done
  1    General failure, or a declined confirmation
  20   The run is blocked
  21   The run is paused or waiting, such as at an approval gate, or another
       process holds the repository or the run
  22   The run failed, or the operation is invalid in the run's state
  64   Usage error
  65   Invalid setup, configuration, or input file
  66   A handoff failed protocol validation
  130  Interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT); SIGTERM ends with 143

Run 'forgecycle help <command>' or 'forgecycle <command> --help' for a
command's arguments and options.
```
